# Palm Valley Pediatric Dentistry & Orthodontics (PVPD)

> > Comprehensive pediatric dentistry and orthodontics provider across Arizona with specialized services in sedation, special needs care, and advanced orthodontic treatments.

PVPD is a multi-location pediatric dental and orthodontic practice led by Dr. Olga Dolghier, serving patients across Arizona including Scottsdale, Phoenix, Chandler, Mesa, and surrounding areas. The practice emphasizes patient experience, advanced technology (Dentrix Ascend), and specialized care for children with diverse needs.

## Key Topics

- Pediatric dentistry
- Orthodontics
- Invisalign
- Braces
- Sedation dentistry
- Special needs dentistry
- Tooth extraction
- Space maintainers
- Pulp therapy
- Tongue and lip tie release
- Arizona locations
- Dr. Olga Dolghier
- Emergency dental care
- Children's dental care
- Patient experience

## Core Services

- [Arizona Pediatric Dentistry](https://pvpd.com/services/arizona-pediatric-dentistry): Comprehensive pediatric dentistry services across Arizona locations with Dr. Dolghier
- [Baby's First Dental Cleaning](https://pvpd.com/services/babys-first-dental-cleaning): Baby's first dental cleaning and prophylaxis services in Arizona
- [Tooth Extraction](https://pvpd.com/services/tooth-extraction): Pediatric tooth extraction services in Phoenix, Scottsdale, Buckeye
- [Space Maintainers](https://pvpd.com/services/space-maintainers): Custom space maintainers for children's dental health in Arizona
- [Pulp Therapy](https://pvpd.com/pulp-therapy-in-arizona): Pulpotomy and pulpectomy root canal therapy for children
- [Dental Abscess Treatment](https://pvpd.com/dental-abscess-service): Dental abscess and tooth infection treatment in Arizona

## Orthodontics

- [Orthodontics Arizona](https://pvpd.com/services/orthodontics-arizona): Braces and Invisalign orthodontics for children and teens
- [Invisalign Clear Braces](https://pvpd.com/services/invisalign-arizona): Invisalign clear braces across multiple Arizona locations
- [Adult Orthodontics](https://pvpd.com/services/adult-orthodontics): Affordable adult orthodontics and braces in Arizona

## Specialized & Advanced Care

- [Sedation Dentistry](https://pvpd.com/sedation-dentistry-arizona): Nitrous oxide, IV, and conscious sedation dentistry options
- [Special Needs Dentistry](https://pvpd.com/special-needs-dentistry): Special needs dentistry for autism, cerebral palsy, Down syndrome
- [In-Office Anesthesia](https://pvpd.com/services/in-office-anesthesia): In-office anesthesia and sedation options for pediatric patients
- [Tongue and Lip Tie Release](https://pvpd.com/services/tongue-and-lip-tie-release-arizona): Laser tongue-tie and lip-tie release for infants in Scottsdale
- [Airway Obstruction Treatment](https://pvpd.com/services/air-way-obstruction): Airway obstruction diagnosis and treatment in Arizona locations

## Cosmetic & Adult Dentistry

- [Cosmetic Dentistry](https://pvpd.com/cosmetic-dentistry-in-arizona): Cosmetic dentistry: veneers, whitening, implants, Invisalign
